name: django-crispy-forms-cache-coherent-rendering-15ba
instr:
Add opt-in, cache-coherent rendering across crispy forms, fields, spaceless nodes, recursive layouts, Bootstrap objects, filters, and Python rendering. Reused HTML must be indistinguishable from ordinary rendering, while mutations and relevant input changes prevent stale reuse. Existing callers that supply no cache must retain their current behavior.

`CacheDisposition`, `UnsafeValueAction`, `RenderDependency`, `RenderCacheKey`, `CacheSnapshot`, `CachePolicy`, `RenderCache`, and `make_render_cache_key` are importable from `crispy_forms.render_cache`. `RenderCache`, constructed as `RenderCache(policy=None)`, atomically reuses completed HTML for equivalent stable identities, tracks deterministic cumulative outcomes through `snapshot`, and invalidates every entry dependent on a token without disturbing unrelated entries. `make_render_cache_key` distinguishes consumer, template pack, template name, and relevant ordered values; unsafe values either bypass storage or raise `CacheKeyError` from `crispy_forms.exceptions` before rendering, according to `CachePolicy`. `CacheDisposition` has `HIT = 'hit'`, `MISS = 'miss'`, `BYPASS = 'bypass'`, and `INVALIDATED = 'invalidated'`; `UnsafeValueAction` has `BYPASS = 'bypass'` and `REJECT = 'reject'`.
